articles.summary: CINCINNATI, Ohio – Cintas Corporation (Nasdaq: CTAS) has earned a spot on FORTUNE’s 2026 World’s Most Admired Companies list.
articles.title: FORTUNE Names Cintas to its 2026 World’s Most Admired Companies List

articles.summary: Cintas has been named to Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Workplaces for Entry Level 2026, recognizing its commitment to early career growth and support.
articles.title: Cintas Earns Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Workplaces for Entry Level 2026 Award

articles.summary: Cintas Corporation today reported results for its fiscal 2026 third quarter ended February 28, 2026. Revenue for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 was $2.84 billion compared to $2.61 billion in last year’s third quarter, an increase of 8.9%.
articles.title: Cintas Corporation Announces Fiscal 2026 Third Quarter Results
